title: FarmProtect+
description: 🌾 Lightweight farmland protection plugin that prevents crops and farmland from explosion damage. Includes MultiWorld support, and simple configuration for survival and SMP servers.
body:
# 🌾 FarmProtect+

> **A lightweight and modern farmland protection plugin designed for survival and economy Minecraft servers.**

> **Protect crops and farmland from explosions while keeping your server optimized and easy to manage.**

> 🔷 **Dependencie - No dependencies required**

> 💬 **Need help or support?**
> **Join our Discord ➟** [Click Here](https://discord.gg/QY6wsN64w3)

---

# ✨ Features

* 💥 Explosion protection for farmland & crops
* 🌍 Optional MultiWorld support
* ⚡ Lightweight and performance friendly
* 🔄 Automatic update checking & downloading
* 🛠 Simple configuration system
* 🧩 Works perfectly for SMP and survival servers

---

# 🌍 MultiWorld Support

By default, MultiWorld support is disabled.

You can enable it by:

```bash
/fp toggle multiworld
```

or by editing the config.yml file manually.

Add or remove worlds anytime using:

```bash
/fp add <world>
/fp remove <world>
```

---

# 💥 ExplosionProtect Support

FarmProtect can protect farmland and crops from all types of explosions.

Enabled by default:

```yaml
ExplosionProtect: true
```

Disable it anytime with:

```bash
/fp toggle explosionprotect
```

---

# 🌱 Supported Crops

Currently supports protection for:

* Wheat
* Melon Seeds
* Pumpkin Seeds
* Carrots
* Potatoes

---

# 🔄 Update Checking / Auto Updating

FarmProtect uses Gravity's Updater system.

The plugin can:

* Check for updates automatically
* Download updates for the next restart

Config options:

```yaml
UpdateCheck: true
AutoUpdate: true
```

If you do not want these features, simply set them to `false`.

---

# 📦 Commands

| Command                                | Description                       |
| -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `/farmprotect reload`                  | Reloads the config                |
| `/farmprotect toggle`                  | Opens toggle help menu            |
| `/farmprotect toggle multiworld`       | Toggle MultiWorld support         |
| `/farmprotect toggle explosionprotect` | Toggle ExplosionProtect           |
| `/farmprotect add <world>`             | Add world to protection list      |
| `/farmprotect remove <world>`          | Remove world from protection list |

---

# 🔐 Permissions

| Permission                            | Description                    | Default |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- |
| `farmprotect.reload`                  | Allows `/farmprotect reload`   | op      |
| `farmprotect.toggle.*`                | Allows all toggle commands     | op      |
| `farmprotect.multiworld.toggle`       | Allows MultiWorld toggle       | op      |
| `farmprotect.explosionprotect.toggle` | Allows ExplosionProtect toggle | op      |
| `farmprotect.addworld`                | Allows adding worlds           | op      |
| `farmprotect.removeworld`             | Allows removing worlds         | op      |

---

# ⚙️ Default Configuration

```yaml
ExplosionProtect: true

MultiWorld: false
Worlds:
   - world
   - world_nether

UpdateCheck: true
AutoUpdate: true
```

---

# 🚀 Simple • Fast • Reliable

FarmProtect is built to provide simple farmland protection without unnecessary complexity — keeping your players focused on building, farming, and enjoying survival gameplay.
